durability: Un-deployed work lives OUTSIDE the repo until flush. This manifest AND every referenced prose file MUST be parked in the project knowledge panel between authoring sessions, or the backlog is only as durable as the chat. Re-upload alongside canon; each session reads this, appends (last-write-wins per objection_id), re-emits.

policy.atomicity: Two separate atomic units. (1) Per-node fold into all surfaces is batchable and MUST checkpoint per node. (2) Deploy = push both branches -> verify-live (curl x3 agreement) -> pin, runs ONCE, LAST, only after every pending node is confirmed across all four surfaces. A mid-run crash resumes from the last folded node and cannot half-update live, because deploy is the final step, never interleaved.
policy.batch_size_note: Default conservative. Calibrate on the FIRST real batch: if Cowork finishes with headroom, raise; if it strains toward its own timeout, lower. Never exceed what Cowork can complete in a single run; if the backlog exceeds the cap, run two deploys, never one over-long one. Operator-adjustable.
policy.flush_trigger: EARLIER of: (a) pending_count >= batch_size_cap; (b) any pending node must go public; (c) operator-initiated. Operator-adjustable.
policy.release_model: Batching supersedes per-node release_vX.json seeds. ONE release is stamped per flush (covering every node in the batch), via library-pin.py after live == new.
policy.canon_bump_per_flush: One MINOR bump per flush covers the whole batch (score/prose/sources revisions; no invariant-block entry revised; counts 81/35/81 unchanged; grades render-time). Confirm at foldin.
policy.interim_invariant: Between flushes, corpus + ledger LEAD live by this pending set. Correct GREEN state is: pin == live == last-flushed-batch, AND corpus ahead by this manifest. Deliberate lag, NOT drift — do not 'fix' it outside a flush.

sources_value: Utility monster (Nozick, Anarchy, State, and Utopia, 1974)

short_medium.medium: "The good outweighs the bad" runs on agent-neutral hedonic aggregation—a net balance of pleasure over suffering, indifferent by construction to whose pleasure and whose pain get summed. Grant commensurability, grant the sum comes out positive: the slogan still licenses the transaction its own user rejects. An aggregation blind to who carries which entry licenses the utility monster—the sadist whose delight outweighs, magnitude for magnitude, the victim's agony, making the torture the optimum. Recoil from that, as nearly everyone does, and you have abandoned agent-neutral aggregation as a principle of justification, which means you cannot reach for it to license procreation either. The one thing that blocks the monster is a side-constraint—the separateness of persons, the refusal to make one being's welfare raw material for another's surplus—and that constraint, applied consistently, equally forbids conscripting a non-consenting newcomer into guaranteed harm for the sake of an aggregate. The rescue closes the case it was meant to save. Justify procreation by expected value across possible lives and the aggregation is interpersonal—the monster's structure exactly; justify it by the actual child's net balance and you presuppose the very subject whose creation is in question, since a foregone joy deprives no one when there is no one yet to deprive. Against the naive aggregator that is decisive; against someone who denies the asymmetry it relocates the dispute rather than ending it—but it strips the slogan of any force of its own.
short_medium.short: The calculus that turns "joy outweighs harm" into "so create" is the same one that turns "a sadist's pleasure outweighs his victim's pain" into "so torture"—a hedonic sum is blind to who carries which entry. Reject that monster, as you do, and you've dropped the principle doing the justifying; whatever blocks the monster also forbids drafting a newcomer into guaranteed harm to fund a sum that was never theirs.

short_medium.medium:
Solipsism is the epistemic, not metaphysical, member of the suffering-denial family: it concedes suffering is bad — your own is undeniable — but asks how you could know you impose it on anyone, since every other mind is inferred and admits a defeater, the behaviorally seamless zombie. The attribution genuinely is defeasible, so the reply concedes the uncertainty and denies only that it does the exculpatory work.

The core needs no asymmetry. Skepticism is reciprocal: every other mind is unprovable from the solipsist's seat, but his own is exactly as unprovable from every other seat. "Mine is certain, yours inferred" is a fact about which chair one sits in, not about minds — the gap is indexical. So doubting the child's suffering while trusting his own is special-pleading: a warrant he grants himself and denies everyone else, one that cannot even enter the public adjudication of permissibility. And conceivability cuts every way: if the child can be a zombie so can his partner and his future self, yet he suspends the doubt for exactly the being whose creation he wants cleared — a one-way ratchet, betrayed by a life spent grieving and demanding to be understood.

Retreat to mere caution only hands the next move its premise. Acting under uncertainty about whether you create a subject of suffering is the structure for restraint, not permission — the hunter firing into a bush he cannot confirm empty is not exculpated by the doubt. The asymmetry sharpens this to weak dominance: non-creation costs nothing whether or not anyone is there, while creation risks real harm in the only branch where someone is, at any probability of sentience. That step leans on the asymmetry and says so; deny it and the dispute reopens as expected value, but the first two moves stand without it.

None of this refutes solipsism as a metaphysics — nothing can, from inside. It defeats it as a license. The global skeptic who doubts even his own mind escapes only by forfeiting every warrant that could justify a birth, so the dialectic dissolves rather than resolving in his favor.
short_medium.short: Other-minds skepticism is reciprocal: every other mind is unprovable from the solipsist's seat, but his own is just as unprovable from every other. "Mine is certain, yours inferred" tracks which chair he sits in, not which beings have minds — so doubting the child while trusting himself is special-pleading. Conceivability cuts every way; he suspends the doubt only for the being whose creation he wants cleared, all while grieving and demanding to be understood. Granting the uncertainty changes nothing: creating a possible subject of suffering is the structure for caution, not permission, and under the asymmetry non-creation costs nothing whether or not anyone is there. This defeats solipsism not as a metaphysics — nothing can — but as a license to procreate.
